summary.intent: Work through pending todos: implement CTR encryption mode for SDK media uploads (PR #399), fix BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging (PR #400), and fix the release gate failing to detect successful desktop E2E test runs (PR #401).
summary.outcome: All three PRs merged to main. SDK now selects CTR vs GCM based on MIME type and file size with a centralized shared module; a missing PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint was added; 9 API test files with stale mock typing patterns were fixed; the release gate was rewritten to search desktop-e2e.yml runs directly instead of inspecting ci-e2e.yml orchestrator job results.

repo: The SDK's selectEncryptionMode logic was duplicated between packages/sdk/src/client.ts and apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts — centralized in packages/sdk-core/src/encryption-mode.ts.
setByoStatus() was a dead service method in the vault module — it existed but had no controller endpoint, meaning BYO mode could never be toggled via the API.

The release gate (release-gate.yml) was searching ci-e2e.yml orchestrator runs for desktop E2E results, but successful desktop tests ran as standalone desktop-e2e.yml workflow runs and were never found.
The ci-e2e.yml orchestrator skips desktop jobs when no desktop-related files change per-commit, causing the release gate to always see 'no desktop tests executed' for most commits.

The target/ directory (Rust build artifacts and doc output) was being scanned by ESLint, producing 261 spurious errors — only target/debug/ and target/doc/ subdirs were not ignored, only src-tauri/target/ was.

API test files use jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> pattern but then re-assign via module.get(), which returns the full type and drops mock method recognition — the correct pattern is to use the original mock variable directly.

The load test's ipns-publish call was sending { ipnsName, cid } but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires { ipnsName, record, metadataCid } — the load test bypasses the SDK and needs signed IPNS records from createAndPublishIpnsRecord.
Husky hooks modified by Entire CLI (commit-msg, commit-msg.pre-entire) should be listed in .git/info/exclude rather than committed, to avoid polluting diffs for other contributors.

The openapi.json was accidentally written to apps/api/openapi.json (cwd) during manual generation instead of packages/api-client/openapi.json — the pnpm api:generate script writes to the correct location.

code.finding: Centralized STREAMING_MIME_TYPES set, CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD (256KB), selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size), and normalizeEncryptionMode() — shared by SDK client and web app.
selectEncryptionMode was duplicated here before centralization; now imports from sdk-core.
Local selectEncryptionMode(file: File) was replaced with a thin wrapper delegating to sdk-core's selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size).
Added PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint using SetByoStatusDto and SetByoStatusResponseDto — previously setByoStatus() was only a service method with no route.
Replaced 97-line dual-source orchestrator job introspection with 27-line direct search of desktop-e2e.yml runs by SHA range.
Added target/** to ESLint ignores — reduced lint errors from 262 to 1 warning by excluding Rust build artifacts.
createByoClientPool now enables BYO mode on each account via the new PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint, and filters out accounts where enable fails, throwing if zero succeed.
ipns-publish step was sending wrong fields — replaced with createAndPublishIpnsRecord from sdk-core. createSdkContext was also being called inside the per-iteration loop instead of being hoisted.

workflow: When vi.mock() replaces an entire module with a factory object, new exports added to that module break tests silently at runtime — switch to importOriginal + spread pattern to survive future export additions.
After adding a new API endpoint, pnpm api:generate must be run and all generated files in packages/api-client/src/ committed, not just specific files, to avoid CI drift checks failing.
When debugging CI gate failures, check whether the gate is searching the right workflow file — the workflow that triggered the run may differ from the workflow that performed the gating check.
Before building on a stale branch, check git pull — the transcript showed todo files duplicated in both pending/ and done/ due to a merge that included both copies.
CodeRabbit review can be manually triggered mid-session with a @coderabbitai please review comment to get inline feedback before the PR is approved.

friction: pnpm api:generate includes a lint step that scans Rust target/ files, causing the generate command to fail with 261 errors unrelated to the API — required an eslint.config.js fix before api:generate could complete cleanly.
The GraphQL reviewThreads API timed out repeatedly, requiring fallback to REST to fetch PR comments.
sdk-core build output was stale during typecheck of sdk package — required rebuilding sdk-core first before the SDK would typecheck clean.
Background tasks (commit, push) completing after the main work was already done created notification noise with no actionable content.
The orval generation created new model files and directories that were not all staged, causing a CI api-client drift check failure that required a follow-up commit.
Husky hook files modified by Entire CLI kept appearing in git status, requiring two rounds of investigation before landing on the .git/info/exclude solution.
The release gate fix required three iterations: fix 'stop at first failed run', then discover the real issue is wrong workflow file, then simplify to direct desktop-e2e.yml search.
open_items: delegated-routing.client.spec.ts:60 has a remaining @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any warning — the only lint issue left after eslint.config.js fix.
MigrationStatusDto.completedAt is typed as 'object' in the generated API client due to a Phase 35 DTO definition issue — flagged as not-applicable in PR review but not fixed.

setByoStatus has no transaction or optimistic lock — a TOCTOU window exists between findVault and setByoStatus, dismissed as not applicable because no vault deletion endpoint exists but worth revisiting if vault deletion is added.
BYO enable in createByoClientPool is sequential (one PATCH per account) — a Copilot comment suggested batching for large pools; dismissed as premature but relevant if pool sizes grow beyond ~50.
Todo pending: Exclude Rust target/ directory from ESLint was created but immediately resolved inline — the todo file in done/ is correct but was created and completed in the same session.

Todos pending on main: Offload large file encryption to Web Worker (ui), Add ERC-1271 contract wallet authentication support (auth), Research CRDT-based IPNS inbox (architecture), Make search index build async/incremental (ui), Add alternative MFA factor types (auth), Investigate removal of mock-ipns-routing layer (api).
